title: PyNorma Testbed — benchmark reference manifest
description: Human-verified ground-truth labels for messy CSV/XLSX table-detection references. Raw data is NOT committed (see .gitignore); rebuild with: python testbed/fetch.py

labeling_spec.header: row index of the column-name row; -1 if the table has no header
labeling_spec.bottom: last DATA row, inclusive (excludes trailing total/footnote/blank rows)
labeling_spec.multi_table: one region per table; primary describes the first (top-left) table
labeling_spec.primary.clean_cols: expected cleaned column count (null if ragged/ambiguous)
labeling_spec.primary.clean_rows: approx expected cleaned data-row count (null if unsure); scored with tolerance

files.name: bls_cps_occupation_by_industry_2015

source.provider: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, CPS annual averages table cpsaat17 (employed persons by occupation, industry, sex, race), via rfordatascience/tidytuesday (2021-02-23)
source.license: US Government public domain (U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics work); mirror repo rfordatascience/tidytuesday

files.notes: BLS CPS table: 3-row merged header (r3 stub label + r4 top occupation groups + r5 leaf columns), title r0, unit row r1 ([In thousands]), NOTE footnote r133. Single table r7-131 with six embedded demographic panels (TOTAL/Men/Women/White/Black/Asian = ghost dimension) as interior group-header rows, interior blank separators, and hierarchical subtotal rows (Manufacturing=Durable+Nondurable). Col0 is industry row-header.

files.name: census_h1_income_limits

source.provider: U.S. Census Bureau, Historical Income Tables: Households, Table H-1 (Asian alone-or-in-combination), redistributed via rfordatascience/tidytuesday (2021-02-09)
source.license: US Government public domain (U.S. Census Bureau work); mirror repo rfordatascience/tidytuesday

files.notes: Census Table H-1 income limits: FOUR stacked sub-tables (Current$/Asian-alone-or-combo, Current$/Asian-alone, 2019$/Asian-alone-or-combo, 2019$/Asian-alone), each with a repeated 2-row merged header (Year, Number, 'Upper limit of each fifth' spanning Lowest/Second/Third/Fourth, Lower limit of top 5 percent). Separated by title/section rows, not blank gaps. Trailing Source/Footnotes rows r97-98. Year cells carry footnote markers like '2017 (40)'.

files.name: dat8_chipotle_orders

source.provider: justmarkham/DAT8 (General Assembly Data Science teaching repo); data originally from the TidyText/Chipotle order dataset
source.license: unknown (public teaching repo, no explicit LICENSE file)

files.notes: Tab-delimited despite .csv extension (utf-8-sig BOM). Clean header at row 0, single full-grid table. Cell-level messiness: 'NULL' missing markers in choice_description, $-prefixed currency strings in item_price, and bracketed multi-value ingredient lists in choice_description (1NF violation).

files.name: diabetes_missing_data
files.notes: Pima-style diabetes dataset: clean header at row 0, single rectangular 9-col table. Only messiness is empty cells for missing values (Serum_Insulin, Skin_Fold, Diastolic_BP, BMI). Region is the whole grid; first/last cols always filled so bounds are unambiguous.

files.name: github_messy_data
files.notes: Clean header at row 0 (alpha..eta), single full-grid 7-col table. Messiness: some empty zeta/epsilon cells (missing), and negative numbers stored as text with a leading apostrophe (e.g. '-2, '-45) in beta/delta -> mixed types.

files.name: global_world_cities
files.notes: Clean single tidy table, header at row 0 (name,country,subcountry,geonameid); only quirk is UTF-8 BOM and many non-ASCII/multilingual city names.

files.name: goodbooks_books
files.notes: Clean header at row 0, single wide 23-col table; authors cell packs multiple comma-separated authors (1NF violation), some blank language_code cells.
